request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve, with a total on-chain withdrawal of 540,750 ADA including a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Dolos is a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides efficient chain-data access without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos exposes five query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost HTTP, UTxO-RPC gRPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros Node-to-Client Unix socket compatible with Cardano-cli, Ogmios, and other tooling.
The Dolos repository has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope covers dependency updates, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, feedback-driven enhancements, and public developer communication.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission.
The requested amount does not, at time of submission, individually or in aggregate breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit, administrative oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect administration and technically capable third parties.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.
Intersect will manage the withdrawn funds through Treasury Reserve and Project-Specific Smart Contracts with specified admin, leadership, and external oversight committee authorization thresholds.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Dolos maintenance, support, AI-workflow documentation, administration, and smart-contract-managed disbursement under Intersect oversight.
